inventory.notes: One donkey with red glasses and pink bandana, no tack; four legs counted; one easel; one teal cable to one small pale server tower on the horizon. Tool: black fountain pen. Canvas: typeset page: title bar, two columns of lines, boxed pink chart. No text or logos. Inspected at 554px on a contact sheet and at 72px, not on quadrant crops.

contact.notes: Grounded hooves sit on the ground shadow; the raised hoof holds: black fountain pen; easel legs on the ground; cable meets the easel foot and the tower base.
